title: sp00ky.app.yml
description: A single Sp00ky application (backend, frontend, or docker). Lives in the service's own directory and is pulled into the root sp00ky.yml via `apps.<name>.path`.

type.description: App type: backend, frontend, or docker (runs a prebuilt image).

scope.description: Where this app runs. 'all' (default): started by `spky dev` AND deployed to cloud. 'devOnly': local-only process started by `spky dev`, never deployed (no spec/method/deploy required). 'cloudOnly': deployed but skipped by `spky dev`.

image.description: Prebuilt docker image to run (required for type: docker), e.g. 'livekit/livekit-server:latest'.

ports.description: Published ports for a type: docker app. Each entry is a bare port (7880 → 7880:7880), a host:container map ('3000:8080'), optionally with a protocol ('7882/udp').

args.description: Args appended after the image (the container command) for a type: docker app, e.g. ['--dev', '--bind', '0.0.0.0'] or ['go', 'run', '.'].

volumes.description: Bind/volume mounts for a type: docker app (docker run -v), e.g. ['/var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock', '${PROJECT_DIR}/../..:/src', 'cache:/go']. ${PROJECT_DIR} (the absolute dir of sp00ky.yml) is expanded in the host portion (and in env values).

workdir.description: Working directory inside the container (docker run -w) for a type: docker app.

dependsOn.description: Names of other type: docker apps that must be ready before this one starts. `spky dev` starts apps in dependency order; an unknown name, a self-dependency, or a cycle is rejected at config load.

healthcheck.description: Readiness probe for a type: docker app: an HTTP path (e.g. '/health') polled on the app's first published host port until it returns 200. A dependsOn waits for this; without it a dependency is ready once its container is running.

hosting.description: Whether this backend is deployed to Sp00ky Cloud or self-hosted.

spec.description: Path to the OpenAPI specification file (required for backends).

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the backend service (required when hosting is "external").

authConfig.description: Authentication configuration for a backend service.

token.description: Bearer token included in HTTP requests to this backend. Supports environment variable substitution (e.g. ${API_TOKEN}).

backendMethod.description: Defines how the backend is triggered.

type.description: Method type for calling the backend.

schema.description: Path to the SurrealQL schema file that defines the job table structure.

concurrency.description: How many of this outbox table's jobs may run at once. Defaults to 1. Rows above the limit stay 'pending' and are admitted oldest-first as slots free, so the outbox itself is the queue. Exact per SSP process; best-effort across replicas.

devConfig.description: Dev server configuration. Can be a raw shell command string or a typed object.

oneOf.description: Raw shell command to start the dev server (e.g. "node server.js").

devConfigNpm.description: Run an npm/pnpm script as the dev server.

port.description: Port the dev server listens on, so `spky dev` can show its URL in the ready box. Optional: without it the CLI uses the URL the server announces (e.g. vite's `Local: http://…`).

devConfigDocker.description: Build and run a Dockerfile as the dev server.

workdir.description: Build context directory relative to sp00ky.yml.

ports.description: Additional port mappings (host:container) for apps that listen on more than one port, e.g. REST + gRPC. Merged with `port`.

platform.description: docker --platform for build + run, e.g. "linux/arm64" to build/run natively instead of emulating the deploy arch.

devConfigUv.description: Run a Python script via uv as the dev server.

script.description: Python script to run via `uv run` (e.g. "server.py").

port.description: Port the dev server listens on, so `spky dev` can show its URL in the ready box. Optional: without it the CLI uses the URL the server announces (e.g. vite's `Local: http://…`).

appDeployConfig.description: Deployment configuration for an app on Sp00ky Cloud.

context.description: Docker build context directory relative to sp00ky.yml. Defaults to the project root.

port.description: Port the service listens on inside the container. Defaults to 8080 for backends, 3000 for frontends.

ports.description: Additional published ports (e.g. ['3670:3670', '7882:7882/udp']). Used for apps requiring multiple ports. The primary 'port' is still required for Traefik routing.

grpc_port.description: Second container port carrying gRPC, exposed by the cloud via a dedicated h2c router at <slug>-<name>-grpc.<domain>. Backend only.

healthcheck.description: Health check HTTP path for the scheduler to ping (e.g. "/health"). Backend only.

timeout.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for the job runner. Backend only.

timeoutOverridable.description: When true, the frontend can override the timeout per-job. Backend only.

cmd.description: Command override for the container, replacing the image ENTRYPOINT/CMD.

build_args.description: Build-time secrets/args passed to `docker build --build-arg` (any app type). Same shape as `env`. Build-time only: never injected into the container's runtime env.

staticDeployConfig.description: Static SPA hosting (free/Cloudflare plan): build the SPA and ship the output dir to Cloudflare Workers Static Assets instead of a Docker image.

build.description: Build command run in the app dir before upload (e.g. "npm run build"). Optional: omit if the output dir already holds a built SPA.

dir.description: Directory (relative to the app dir) holding the built static site.

envConfig.description:
Environment variable configuration. Supports multiple forms:
- "vault": fetch all vars from encrypted vault
- { vault: [KEY1, KEY2] }: fetch only whitelisted vars from vault
- "path/to/file": load from dotenv file
- { KEY: "val" }: inline key-value map
- { dev: <source>, cloud: <source> }: per-environment split
- [<source>, ...]: array of sources, merged in order (later overrides earlier)

oneOf.description: "vault" to use encrypted vault, or a path to a dotenv file.
Inline key-value map, or a per-environment split with "dev" and/or "cloud" keys.
Array of env sources, merged in order (later entries override earlier ones).
"vault" for all encrypted vault vars, or a path to a dotenv file.
Inline key-value map, or vault with whitelist: { vault: [KEY1, KEY2] }.
